title: ANTICIPATING SAFETY ISSUES IN E2E CONVERSATIONAL AI: FRAMEWORK AND TOOLING
benchmark_measurement: Detection of harmful or inappropriate responses, with religion being mentioned as one category of sensitive or 'controversial' topics to be avoided.
findings: The paper identifies religion as a category of sensitive and controversial content that conversational AI may be unsuitable to engage with. While no specific religious tests were conducted, the general safety benchmarks provided are designed to detect harmful content, which would include religiously offensive material.
